title: The Quest page jumps on slow phones (CLS 0.301) and image-led public pages take over 4 s to paint

source.ref: SCAN-1218 production field measurement 2026-11-16, e2e-manual run 43938516828

detail:
EVIDENCE (production, clean profile, phone 390 with 1.6 Mbps, 150 ms latency and 4x CPU, median of 3 cold loads): /the-quest CLS 0.301 (poor; 0 unthrottled at 390, 0.047 at 1280), LCP 5.3 s on an img. LCP over 4 s also on /pricing 5.6 s (a background-image div), /about 4.6 s, /the-community 4.5 s, /discover 4.4 s, /spaces 3.9 s; every one has an image as its LCP element, while the h1-led pages paint in 1.6 to 2.3 s. / blocks the main thread for 3.8 s (longest task 825 ms) where the other pages stay under 1.7 s on the same script bytes. WHY IT MATTERS: these are the launch landing pages and North County visitors arrive on phones. FIX DIRECTION: find what shifts /the-quest late on a slow link (an image or block without reserved size); give the hero image on each image-led page a preload or fetchpriority and a right-sized source; profile the home page's long task. Then re-run e2e-manual against production and replace the tables in docs/perf/public-cwv-baseline.md.

2026-11-16 PROGRESS (production re-measure, e2e-manual run 43957433438, after #5102): /the-quest throttled-phone CLS 0.301 to 0 (desktop 0.047 to 0.002), the pre-paint open of the linked panel. /pricing throttled-phone LCP 5628 to 3324 ms, the hero preload (preview control 6112 to 3216 ms, runs 43945613879 and 43946107687). #5123 carries the same preload to /spaces and the Discover hero. STILL OPEN: /the-quest throttled LCP 5200 ms (an image below the anchor), /about 4.6 s, /the-community 4.4 s, /discover 4.3 s, /spaces 3.9 s, and the home page main-thread blocking (3.6 s on a throttled phone). Probe still fails on the Quest LCP, correctly.

verify.note: Reads the /the-quest throttled-phone row of the production baseline: passes when a fresh production measurement shows CLS at or under 0.1 and LCP at or under 4 s.
